name: Lyrmark
description: The K-class light of Lyrmark has guided three generations of drift miners and twice as many ghosts. Survey crews logged eccentric comets and a trojan swarm before moving on to richer claims. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

stars.name: Red Beacon
stars.description: A K-class star burning orange, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Ephemeris updates track its slow variability across the decades.

stars.name: Ashen Bell
stars.description: A G-class star burning yellow, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Its light curve is a calibration standard for the whole sector.

planets.name: Calmvast
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

moons.name: Quartz Crag I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: Gildedreach
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Subsurface warmth is rumored, and twice confirmed, and never shared. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

planets.name: Hollowgarde
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Geysers of sublimating ice erupt along the terminator line. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

moons.name: Gilded Gravel I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: The Calm deep
planets.description: Temperate bands of green and gold suggest a biosphere in full swing. Rain follows the mountain ranges, and rivers braid the lowlands. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

dwarfPlanets.name: Silent Nether 43
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

belts.name: Moss Band
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Late Lantern
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
